body:
Amanita Muscaria (BEWARE!)
I tried this thinking I would have a joyfull experience.
My experiences I have taken LSD, Salvia, Hawaiian Baby Woodrose, Mushrooms (cubensis) and all I can say is the I had the worst experience on Amanita Muscaria.  I felt like I was going to die.
I couldnt handle the taste of eating them by themself so I made a fruit smoothie, and pour em in.  Drinking it was still quite unpleasent cause the taste is quite nastypowerful.
As for the experience about 30 min later I started feeling the back of my throat twitch	inggle. That LSD sign for me that I am about to trip.  Wasnt too worried as I enjoyed the slow come on.
The peak.  This was horrible I was sweating so much, and my stomach was in such a cramp I couldnt move.  I just laid on my bed as waves of HOT, and Cold flushed over me.  When I got hot I would pour sweat from my body, and the cold would make me shiver like I fell in a pool of ice water.  The room felt as if it was spinning through time on a cube that was rotating in space.  And my consciousness was coming in and out of that cube.
Overall it was a VERY horrifying experience, and I will never do it again.  Salvia is much more intense, but it did not give me the physical feelings of death.  HBW was a stomachache, but mentally I could enjoy the sensitivity of my other senses.  LSD was a mind boggle, but entertaining.
